BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

3. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   B. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Money as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   B. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

8. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   B. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.

9. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Business Transactions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of Business Transactions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Journals Page 14 of 55 1 STRAND 1.0: BUSINESS AND MONEY MAN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Books of Original Entry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
